title: Real-model semantic search end-to-end (gated specs)
description:
**Files:** `features/02_querying/09_semantic_model.feature` (new; ungated per Ryan's decision — CI runs the real model); `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`; `src/store/vector.rs`; `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs` (embed); `.github/workflows` CI steps (download the model once and cache it, e.g. actions/cache keyed on model version/hash, or a pre-downloaded copy).

**Acceptance:** end-to-end, red first then green: ingest with the real MiniLM embedder → semantic search returns the semantically right fixtures → hybrid ranking composes. Per Ryan's decision (BOTSPY-bb60bb closed): no gating, no @wip, no ignored tests — CI runs the real model on all 8 jobs (incl. Windows and musl); the stub remains an internal unit-test seam only.
